project_name: Somani Fabs - Heritage Shop & Admin Platform

public_landing.vibe: Heritage, Trust, Traditional, Premium Indian Textile
public_landing.reasoning: A heritage fabric shop needs to convey legacy and trust. Warm earthy tones mixed with deep rich textile colors evoke Indian tradition.

admin_app.reasoning: The admin app is a mobile-first POS and session tracking tool. It needs high clarity, dense data presentation, and clear action hierarchies.

led_display.reasoning: Fullscreen display requires deep blacks to blend with screen bezels and high contrast for live try-on image visibility from afar.

headings.usage: Hero headers, section titles to convey heritage.
Dashboard widgets, session cards, modal headers.

rules.tinted_grey: Never use pure #808080. Always tint greys with a touch of blue (for admin) or warm orange (for public).
rules.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Overlays on images must be bg-black/40.

public_landing.grid_mode: Mode A (Tetris Grid) - grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12, wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12).
public_landing.spacing_scale: Generous (p-12, p-16, p-24) to allow storytelling breathing room.
public_landing.alignment: Left-aligned content inside asymmetric grid blocks.

admin_app.grid_mode: Mode B (Control Room Grid) - dense, grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3, gap-4.
admin_app.spacing_scale: Compact (p-4, p-6) for high data density.
admin_app.cards: Flat solid surfaces, 1px subtle border, max rounded-lg, no shadows unless hovering.

led_display.grid_mode: CSS Grid (grid-cols-1, 2, or 4 depending on active splits). No gaps, full bleed images.
led_display.spacing_scale: Absolute minimum. Metadata overlaid at bottom.

public_landing.structure: Pure HTML/Tailwind. Avoid Shadcn containers to allow overlapping and asymmetry.
public_landing.header: Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, border-b border-white/20, z-50).
public_landing.marquee: Slow 'Editorial Ribbon' for brands (Donear, Raymond, Siyaram's). Pale bg, dark text, gap-32.
public_landing.hero_overlay: bg-black/40 over the shop facade image to ensure white text readability.

admin_app.structure: Heavily customized Shadcn UI components for rapid operational flow.
admin_app.session_cards: Grid Items (col-span-1), solid white bg, border-border, displaying customer mobile, name, and start time.

camera_capture_ui.layout: Fullscreen or max-height modal on mobile.
camera_capture_ui.button: Large thumb-zone shutter button (h-16 w-16, rounded-full, bottom-8, absolute).
camera_capture_ui.preview: Real-time camera feed taking 80vh. Immediate post-capture thumbnail reveal.
camera_capture_ui.guide: Overlay framing guide with green ready indicator.

admin_app.tryon_list: Table or dense list view (Fabric Thumbnail | Try-on Thumbnail | Desc | View Button).
admin_app.forms: Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Left-aligned labels.

public_landing.entrance: Fade-in and slight translate-y on scroll for storytelling blocks.

admin_app.feedback: Micro-interactions. Active states must be visibly darker. Toast notifications for session updates.
admin_app.transitions: Instant or 150ms max. Optimize for speed.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs) MUST include `data-testid` in kebab-case, role-based format (e.g., `data-testid="start-session-btn"`).

media_assets.instructions_to_main_agent: Use these EXACT URLs for the respective sections. Do NOT use placeholder domains like via.placeholder.com.

public_hero_background.description: Moody Indian shop facade to serve as the heritage background. Apply bg-black/40 overlay.

heritage_fabric_patterns.description: Traditional Indian fabric pattern for the 'About the Shop' section.
Colorful traditional patterns in Jaipur for storytelling blocks.

suiting_fabric_rolls.description: Folded suiting fabrics for the 'What we sell' section.
Textile rolls on display to showcase inventory.

brands.note: Use typography-based logos for Donear, Raymond, and Siyaram's using Playfair Display or a crisp sans-serif, as generic image logos break immersion.

language_toggle.behavior: Global state toggle (Hinglish / English / Hindi) persisting in localStorage.
language_toggle.ui_placement: Top right of Crystal Header in Public app. Settings drawer in Admin app.
